$comment: Text that reaches structured data rather than the page: entity relationship descriptions, publisher strings and the labels a rich result may show. Entity names themselves are invariant — a knowledge-graph identifier is not a word to translate — but the sentence describing each relationship is read by people in search results, so it is.

entities.robloxCorporation: Operates the Roblox platform and the Developer Exchange programme. Not affiliated with this site.
entities.developerExchangeProgram: The official Roblox programme that converts eligible Earned Robux into currency.
entities.robux: The Roblox virtual currency. Only the earned portion of a balance is eligible for DevEx.
entities.earnedRobux: Robux accumulated through creator activity, and the only category DevEx converts.
entities.creatorHub: Publishes the official DevEx documentation this site cites.
entities.devexPortal: Where a DevEx request is submitted. A valid portal account is a documented requirement.
entities.usd: The currency the DevEx rate is denominated in and the base of every calculation here.
entities.europeanCentralBank: Publishes the euro reference rates used to derive local-currency estimates.
entities.marketplaceFee: The commission Roblox retains when Robux are spent, applied before DevEx and never twice.
entities.ageVerification: Part of the DevEx eligibility requirements and of the U.S. 18+ rate conditions.
entities.taxForm: An IRS form W-9 or W-8 must be on file before a DevEx request can proceed.

stats.name: Roblox creator payout and engagement figures
stats.description: Developer exchange fees, revenue and engagement as Roblox reports them in its SEC filings, with each row labelled reported or derived and linked to the filing it came from. Includes the metrics Roblox does not publish, as absences with reasons.
stats.measurementTechnique: Transcribed from Roblox Corporation SEC filings and shareholder letters. Derived figures are computed in code from reported ones and labelled as such.

platform.name: Observed Roblox player counts
platform.description: Player counts observed every fifteen minutes from Roblox's own public endpoints, for the experiences Roblox was ranking at the time. Nothing is interpolated and no missing observation is filled in; a gap means the collector did not run. This covers only ranked experiences and is not all of Roblox.
platform.measurementTechnique: Recorded server-side from Roblox public games endpoints on a fifteen-minute schedule. Platform totals are retained fourteen days; per-experience series are sampled hourly and retained seven days.
